name: Catesbeianin-1 (Ranidae, Anura, Amphibia, Animals)
evidence_note: Verified primary paper (Biotechnol Lett 2017, PMID 28258530) and patent CN101724632A. Experimental MW is 3144.8 Da, exactly matching the theoretical free acid (-COOH) MW of 3144.85 Da (amidated theoretical is 3142.86 Da). Zero disulfide bonds. Max identity to 417 dev records is 0.3333 (nearest DBAASP:25512). Standard E. coli ATCC 25922 MIC is 3.1 ug/mL (amp=1). Human RBC hemolysis curve gives exactly 50% lysis at 300 ug/mL, satisfying HC50 >= 250 ug/mL (hemo=0).
